plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 4-Hour End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary page instead of searching or recreating the event setup.
Enable the required eRFX project capability before accessing the prepared closed RFQ.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog contains the Product Sheet section.
Confirm the dialog contains Auction Configurations.
Confirm the dialog contains Delivery Date.
Confirm the dialog offers the scheduling choice.
Set the recreated event's end-time duration to 4 hours.
Verify the default 30-minute evaluation duration remains selected.
Verify the recreated event is not scheduled for later.
Create the recreated event using the configured duration and scheduling options.
Verify creation opens an event page for the newly created event.
Confirm the newly created live event displays its bidding end-time field.
Verify the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ's product quantity.
Verify the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ's product unit.
Confirm the recreated event page rendered without errors or malformed values.
